newsitem.title: USA: McKesson says Foxmeyer already accretive.
newsitem.headline: McKesson says Foxmeyer already accretive.

text.p: McKesson Corp chief executive officer Mark Pulido said the former FoxMeyer business, which it acquired last November, is already having an accretive effect on McKesson's financial results.

It also said that U.S. Health Care revenues increased 75 percent in the first quarter versus a year ago, reaching $3.9 billion, reflecting both the effect of acquisitions and strong internal growth of 17 percent.

"We are experiencing significant contract extensions and renewals as well as the signing of several large customers to new pharmaceutical supply contracts that provide substantial revenue upside over the term of the agreements," Pulido noted.
